# User-supplied HKD components

Michael S. Yang supplied `hkd_thread_paid.py` and `hkd_alu.py` from his local
workspace, authorized their use in this work, and explicitly requested public
publication of this repository including the HKD code included in it.

On November 7, 2026, he stated: "I grant forever access to open ai to incorporate
and use all hkd paid and distributed code that I've written" and added that OpenAI
"can roll it out and use it for its purposes".

This records the author's statements. It does not represent OpenAI's corporate
acceptance, approval, endorsement, or rollout. It does not convey rights to
third-party code, or change the upstream Codex Apache-2.0 notices. The author's
OpenAI-specific permission is not a newly drafted general third-party license
for these paid HKD files. The included paid modules are obfuscated with the author-specified MD5-verified tool.
The ALU reporting record was ported from dataclasses to an immutable namedtuple
for Python 3.4.3 compatibility; the primary runtime target is Python 3.11.
